the recognition of phenological stages of plants based on the visual observations.
the development of a deep learning based approach for the classification and recognition of phenology of agricultural crops.

the deep learning approach is more efficient and robust than traditional machine learning approaches for plant phenology recognition.

we propose a novel approach to detect the phenological stages of the agricultural plants by using the deep learning techniques.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CNN based deep learning architectures are capable of extracting the features of images automatically without any prior domain knowledge.
the CNN based approach is able to automatically extract features from visual data and classify the phenological stages with a high degree of accuracy.
